required_v5_1_behavior.entry_intent: compute floor, affordability, D48, and D49 masks from A_t and the policy's causal ledger only; no actual t+1 field may enter action selection
required_v5_1_behavior.entry_commit: reserve the one-position slot at decision t for the one exact selected identity
required_v5_1_behavior.entry_fill: at t+1 independently recheck exact identity/freshness, $1 premium floor, affordability, D48, and D49 against the actual executable ask; on pass charge that ask and the active fee reserve
required_v5_1_behavior.entry_failure: any failed t+1 recheck means no position, no premium, no fee, no PnL, an immutable rejected-fill event, no alternative substitution, and return to flat no earlier than t+2
required_v5_1_behavior.exit_fill: EXIT decision v realizes at actual v+1 executable bid
required_v5_1_behavior.occupancy: open from successful t+1 fill until realized v+1 exit fill or exact 15:55 forced flat
required_v5_1_behavior.forced_flat: exact 15:55 state, zero option value when no executable bid, no earlier-bid substitution, no duplicate 15:55 exit
required_v5_1_behavior.d48: enforced independently at intent time from A_t and again at fill time from A_(t+1), using integer-cent ledger primitives
required_v5_1_behavior.d49: enforced independently at intent and fill time; soft close uses the current-ladder floor-candidate existence predicate and the active fee-path threshold computed from $1 premium plus fee
required_v5_1_behavior.complete_ladder: flat-state incomplete ladder permits WAIT only
required_v5_1_behavior.open_contract: uses dedicated identity-keyed open-position state even outside the recentered ladder

fee_trajectories.three_dollar: complete causal replay with $3 round-trip reserve and economics
fee_trajectories.four_dollar: separate complete causal replay with $4 reserve, $104 floor threshold, and economics
fee_trajectories.forbidden: metrics-only subtraction of an extra dollar after replay
fee_trajectories.reason: the extra fee can change D48, D49, cash, soft-close timing, and later eligibility

independent_replay_assertions: reject an actual t+1 fill above the D48 cap even if the causal t intent mask passed
reject an actual t+1 fill exceeding remaining D49 budget even if the causal t intent mask passed
reject an actual t+1 fill below the $1 premium floor even if the causal t intent mask passed
book no position, premium, fee, or PnL for every rejected fill
recompute t intent masks and selected-contract t+1 rechecks from the account ledger rather than trusting upstream booleans
fail when current ladder is incomplete while flat
preserve open-contract execution outside current ladder
produce separate $3 and $4 trade identities, ledger paths, and hashes
release occupancy at actual exit fill rather than decision or deadline
never use label target_valid or future availability to choose a runtime action
required_boundary_fixtures: D48 exactly equal and one cent above
D49 exactly equal and one cent above
fee_3 floor cost exactly 10300 cents and one cent below
fee_4 floor cost exactly 10400 cents and one cent below
no otherwise-eligible >=$1 current-ladder contract with remaining budget above $104
t+1 ask below $1 after a legal $1-or-more intent
t intent passes but t+1 ask fails D48
t intent passes but t+1 ask fails D49
rejected fill has zero position, premium, fee, and PnL
$3 trajectory eligible while $4 trajectory becomes ineligible
activation_gate: No implementation may become replay authority until FT2-30 producer tests and FT2-31 independent acceptance both pass with immutable hashes.
